svg.title: What is picked: tokens or blocks
svg.desc: Fifteen positions 0–14 in four 4-token blocks. DSA has a search key and score per position and reads the main KV at the top-4 positions 1, 6, 8, 11. QSA has one averaged key per completed block 0–2 with block scores 0.4, 0.5, 0.7 and reads block 2 (positions 8–11) and the tail 12–14.
svg.text: What is picked: tokens or blocks
15 visible positions 0–14, including the current one at 14

g.text: mean of 4 raw keys → RMSNorm → RoPE at the block start → score · dashed = tail raw keys kept until the block fills
teaching budgets differ (real: DSA up to 2,048 positions, QSA up to 512 blocks + tail) · scores are made up · QSA block scores are set separately, not averages of token
